lines: I ship work that holds after launch — not only on the first glance.
Brand character belongs in the interface, not only in the logo file.

about.label: Studio
about.practice: Software · four years · applied AI in live systems
about.p1: I run METEK Digital from Malatya, Türkiye — a founder-led studio for custom websites, admin panels, and automation. Four years in software. Design and engineering stay on one line from first brief to launch.
about.p2: Clients get one accountable delivery lead, not a handoff chain. No marketplace themes. Interfaces are built for the brand and for the people who use them every day.
about.p3: Before handoff I verify mobile speed, core accessibility, and technical SEO. Agreed content surfaces stay editable after launch.
about.doTitle: Sites, panels, and automation in production.
about.doIntro: Public faces for the brand. Internal tools for daily operations. Messaging and AI flows tied to real work — not demos.

items.title: Custom websites
items.body: Marketing and product sites on a modern stack when the job needs it — often Next.js and React. Fast on phones, prepared for search, with a clear path to quote, book, or buy.

items.title: Admin panels & CRM
items.body: Panels for content, leads, and operations. Same hierarchy and craft as the public site — no orphan admin skin.

items.title: AI & automation
items.body: WhatsApp and Instagram bots, intake and follow-up flows. AI only where it removes real work from the path.
